meta.description: Blade ultra-thin magnetic track lights: a 6 mm copper track with 12–41 mm lights, smooth SPWM dimming, MixPad control and museum-grade, eye-friendly light.
daofeng_banner.banner_desc: Smart magnetic track lights as slim as a tile joint
sec2.info:

sec3.title: Thinner than a phone, with the look of a recessed light
sec3.desc: A 6 mm ultra-thin copper magnetic track with light bodies only 12–41 mm deep: a truly ultra-thin, surface-mounted magnetic track system.
sec3.title2: SPWM smart lighting makes every day feel special
sec3.desc2: Brightness and color temperature are set with pulse-wave signals, so the light is less prone to flicker or color shift when the current is unsteady. Changing the pulse duty cycle changes the LED's average current, for smoother dimming and color tuning.
sec5.title:
MixPad smart dimming technology
Change the light as you like, anytime, anywhere
sec6.title:
Ultra-thin magnetic track:
from an engineer's obsession
to a real product
sec6.desc:
15 years of optical expertise
2 years of dedicated R&D
200+ prototypes
100+ naked-eye simulation tests
sec6.desc2: Two years ago, ORVIBO engineers set out to make a magnetic track light with no special installation requirements. Round after round of development produced a new generation of surface-mounted magnetic tracks that look good once installed and give light that is pleasant to live with. The result is a revolutionary magnetic track system.
sec7.title: The utmost care for your eyes, light you can rely on
sec7.desc: Five high-standard core optical features create healthy, museum-grade light. Glare, flicker, color rendering, lifespan and brightness are all tuned for light that feels good for body and mind.
sec8.title: Made to last 20 years, worry-free
sec8.desc: Magnets can weaken over the years and let a light fall. To prevent this, ORVIBO pioneered strong magnetic attachment plus a safety lock: double protection for a safe home. Solid, secure and built to last!
sec9.title:
1,000 lights
in perfect sync
sec12.desc: *All lights above: color temperature adjustable from 2700K to 6000K, brightness from 0 to 100%, color rendering index Ra 90, light source life 50,000 h, no visible flicker.
